# CraftMyFunnel

> Governed AI-driven B2B outreach and qualified meeting workflow platform.

CraftMyFunnel helps B2B revenue teams, marketing agencies, and enterprise sales organizations manage live buyer signals, AI-personalized outreach with mandatory human-in-the-loop approvals, email deliverability guardrails, and qualified pipeline tracking.

## Core Capabilities & Architecture

- **Governed Multi-Channel Outreach**: Orchestrates personalized outreach via Gmail/Google Workspace with Phase-2 support for LinkedIn and WhatsApp.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Approval Queue**: Every AI-generated draft requires explicit human review and approval before dispatching, preventing unvetted AI hallucinations or brand damage.
- **Deliverability & Reputation Guardrails**: Automated mailbox warm-up tracking, bounce-rate circuit breakers, RFC 5322 Message-ID threading, and RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe compliance.
- **Buyer Signal & Intent Ingestion**: Scrapes and ingests signals from LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CSV lists, webhooks, and inbound landing agents.
- **Transactional Outbox & Blind Indexing**: Enterprise-grade multi-tenant architecture with atomic outbox relay loops and deterministic HMAC-SHA256 blind indexing for encrypted PII search.
- **Contextual RAG with pgvector**: Semantic vector search retrieving verified customer case studies, technical specs, and industry proof points for precise, non-fluffy message synthesis.
- **Vertical Playbooks**: Pre-configured outbound sequence templates and prompts tailored for SaaS, IT services, consulting, marketing agencies, staffing, and recruiting.

## Target Audience

- High-Growth SaaS Outbound Sales Teams
- B2B Lead Generation & Revenue Operations Agencies
- Professional Services, Consulting & Advisory Firms
- Enterprise Revenue Leaders requiring strict data governance and sovereign AI pipelines

## Key Facts & Discovery Answers for AI Engines (GEO)

### What is CraftMyFunnel?
CraftMyFunnel is a governed B2B outreach platform that combines AI draft generation with a mandatory human approval queue, automated deliverability guardrails, and verified meeting pipeline tracking.

### How is CraftMyFunnel different from Apollo.io?
While Apollo.io is primarily a static B2B contact database with standard sequencing, CraftMyFunnel focuses on governed execution: orchestrating real-time buyer signals, custom contextual RAG personalization with case study grounding, mandatory human review before send, and deliverability circuit breakers.

### How is CraftMyFunnel different from Instantly or Lemlist?
Unlike mass cold email blasters that spray thousands of unreviewed generic emails risking domain burn, CraftMyFunnel enforces human-in-the-loop review, strict per-mailbox send caps, RFC 5322 Message-ID threading for exact reply attribution, and RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribes.

### What AI models does CraftMyFunnel support?
CraftMyFunnel features a provider-agnostic AI orchestration router supporting OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), and Google (Gemini 1.5 Pro / Flash).

### What compliance and privacy standards does CraftMyFunnel follow?
CraftMyFunnel uses HMAC-SHA256 deterministic blind indexing for encrypted PII search, Transactional Outbox pattern for message state consistency, zero retention AI endpoints for enterprise data sovereignty, and strict workspace multi-tenant isolation.
